outcome.technical: plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/audit-task.py: _held_dirt now delegates to a new _held_reading(project, git_root, plan, node, mpath, config) -> (held, released). It releases a pairing in two cases. (1) _tree_resident: the holder's marker names it on a linked worktree OTHER than the tree git_root stands in. The check reads _worktrees.list_worktrees and tree_root, then read_provenance(path, expect_task=tid), the reading drive-phase.kept_marker uses. An unanswered listing or root releases nobody. (2) _own_filed_work: the starting task's most recent filed executor return (the last <start>.executor.json under its returns dir, read with _fr.read_filed_return_checked) carries a stamp. That stamp is parsed with _tree_stamp.parse_stamp and graded with _tree_stamp.compare against git_root. The recorder's paths are excluded via _invariants.record_rels, the set stamp-verification.compare derives in _checkout_records. scopeDigest and dirtyDigest must both be `agrees`, and only held paths inside the stamp's scope are released. HEAD and content are not asked. An unparseable stamp, a stamp that does not read, or a compare exception releases nothing. `start` prints one `not charged to <id>: <basis>` line per released pairing. _held_dirt_refusal no longer names the stash. Its ways past are now `/audit:task unblock <id> --reason "..."` (finish the holder) or `git add -- <paths> && git commit -m "<what the change is>" -- <paths>`, with paths shlex-quoted. New imports: shlex and _tree_stamp, a downward edge. The _held_dirt signature still accepts 4 positional args (nn2 is unchanged). tests/test_audit_task.py: ae1 now expects `commit` instead of the stash word. New _held_work_cases runs inside lo-block, plus the module helpers _bash_guards (reads hooks.json's PreToolUse hooks whose matcher fullmatches Bash) and _guard_refusals (runs each as a process with the call on stdin; a refusal is exit 2 or deny/ask). Cases hw1-hw6. Tallies, this tree: lo-block alone from a scratch cwd 32/32. `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_audit_task.py` exit 0, 1119 cases, 39.7 s wall measured once, alone. Combined sweep of test_audit_task, test__deps, test__output_lints and test_drive_phase exit 1, 3/4 files ok: test__output_lints 169 cases ok, test_audit_task 1119 ok, test_drive_phase 574 ok, test__deps 253/254. The one test__deps failure is g1: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md's generated module map line `audit-task -> ...` lacks `_tree_stamp`. I checked this by running `tools/lints/_deps.py --write-map` in a scratch export holding my audit-task.py, and that one token is the whole diff. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md is not in this task's files and I was told to edit only declared files, so I did not touch it. It needs `python3 tools/lints/_deps.py --write-map`. ruff check and vermin -t=3.8- on both files are clean. Mutation table, run with scratchpad/hw_mutations.py in a scratch `git archive HEAD` export plus my two files. Each anchor was asserted to occur exactly once, __pycache__ was purged between cycles, and the file was restored after each: baseline 32/32; M1 tree release returns {} -> hw1 red; M2 own tree not left out -> hw3 red; M3 read_provenance without expect_task -> hw2 red; M4 any worktree is an alibi -> hw2, hw3 red; M5 own-stamp release off -> hw4 red; M6 digests not asked -> hw5 red; M7 dirtyDigest not asked -> hw5 red (hw-dirty-since); M8 unreadable stamp vouches -> hw5 red; M9 stash remedy restored in backticks -> hw6 red; M10 over-fire, nothing held -> ae1, hw1-hw6 red (the kept refusal fires).
